source_evidence: Exact player reply: 'To my home. Why are you surveying? For who/what?' V states his destination only as his home and asks their purpose and beneficiary. H1 is surprised at the claim of a home farther along the ruined track, replies that they are scouting for their own captain and armed company, assessing where a formed group can pass, where paths are obstructed and who controls the land; he does not identify the captain, company's allegiance, strength, destination or intended operation. This is a guarded partial truthful disclosure consistent with the already fixed reconnaissance motive, not proof of allegiance to or independence from the Dominion. H1 asks whether V lives here and whether the way ahead is his territory; he makes no demand for a guide or map yet. H2 and H3 remain alert at their existing positions; no attack, spell, weapon draw or shift to automatic friendliness. No new roll because ordinary volunteered limited information, no persuasion success or coerced disclosure. No new player speech, movement or resource use beyond the exact stated words. V chooses next reply or action.
